Historic shrine title and 1962-Missal services never follow automatically from a Marian dedication or from ordinary Mass listings.
No photo may be added to Place profile without exact-license, subject and derivative review.
Use exact original candidate IDs only for research-context crosswalk; no new duplicate Place for a single structure.
